factors: Sev 1 = 35, Sev A = 22, Sev B = 12, Sev C = 3

Frustrated = 8 / Angry = 15, open complaint = 8, 2+ chasers = 6, overdue request = 4

Sev A with no Microsoft update for >= 1 business day (Sev A stalled)

stall: ST1
Microsoft-side
Ball with Microsoft and business days since the last Microsoft update >= threshold (Sev 1/A 1, B 3, C 5).
PB-05 nudge engineer -> L1 after 1 business day; Sev A -> PB-02 duty manager now.
ST2
Blocked (Product Group)
Status Waiting on Product Group and no Microsoft update >= threshold.
Ask for PG ETA + interim workaround; L1 if none within 1 business day.
ST3
Customer-side
Ball with customer/partner and no correspondence for >= 5 business days (Sev 1/A: 2).
PB-06 nudge customer; second nudge +3 business days; propose closure.
ST4
Process (no owner)
No engineer assigned 1+ business day after creation (blank 'Ownership accepted' notification).
PB-10 request assignment through the duty manager.
ST5
Commitment missed
Next Action Due or Resolution ETA in the past while the case is open.
Reset next action / ETA with the engineer; update the customer.
ST6
Blind spot (flag)
No case correspondence visible to the CSM after 1 business day - adds 5 points and a visibility action.
PB-13 check the case in the portal; ask to be CC'd on Sev A/B threads.
triggers: Join CritSit comms; executive update cadence 4h; readiness pack for exec questions.

Duty manager engagement; request update within 2h.
24x7 Case Management / duty manager; inform customer proactively.

Escalation pack + manager approval same day.

Request action plan + ETA; consider SME / PG engagement.
Single accountable owner; handover summary; quality review.

Account review; problem-management request; proactive session.

playbooks: Confirm next action and ETA exist; no customer contact needed today.

Join bridge or get CritSit manager contact -> set 4h executive update cadence -> prepare exec summary -> RCA request logged as Additional Request -> post-incident review within 5 business days of closure.
Ping engineer now -> no reply in 1h: duty manager -> inform customer of actions -> log in Escalations (L2) -> review again at 12:00.
Contact duty manager or 24x7 Case Management -> confirm engineer assignment -> proactive customer message -> track SLA breach in Review Log.
Acknowledge to customer within 2h -> Copilot builds escalation pack -> manager approval card -> submit at suggested level -> daily tracking until de-escalation criteria met.
Template N1 nudge to engineer (ask: status, next step, ETA) -> no reply in 1 business day: engineer's manager / TA (L1) -> still stalled after 2: escalation candidate.
Template C1 reminder -> +3 business days second reminder with call offer -> propose closure / soft close with customer consent.
Acknowledge within 1 business day (template K1) -> classify category -> agree recovery plan with engineer's manager -> close the loop with the customer -> tag root cause.
Qualify (in scope / contract / needs PG) -> assign owner and due date -> confirm expectations to customer -> deliver and record resolution.
Request written action plan + ETA from engineer's manager / TA -> consider SME or PG engagement -> update customer.
Ask duty manager for a single accountable owner -> request handover summary -> monitor for 2 business days.
Account review with manager -> action plan (technical, relationship, commercial) -> exec sponsor alignment -> weekly tracking until Green for 2 weeks.
Confirm resolution with customer within 2 business days -> capture satisfaction -> RCA delivered if requested -> post-incident review for Sev 1/A or escalated cases.
Check case status in the support portal -> ask engineer to CC you on customer updates -> set next action in the list.
